EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Susan Lutz, Pittsfield Township resident and AARP volunteer, spoke about crypto currency fraud. She stated scammers are targeting older citizens with crypto scams using crypto kiosks. She encouraged Council to learn more about crypto currency fraud.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Susan Lutz - Crypto Currency Kiosk Fraud (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Ramon Harris, Southfield resident and Outreach Director for AARP Michigan, spoke about crypto currency fraud using crypto kiosks. He urged Council to take steps locally to help prevent fraud and abuse.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Ramon Harris - Crypto Currency Kiosk (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Anthony Winters, Ypsilanti Township resident and AARP member, spoke about the concerns with crypto currency kiosks. He urged Council to support local restrictions and regulations regarding these kiosks.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Anthony Winters - Crypto Machines (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Cortland Travis Bersee, resident, was not present.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Cortland Travis Bersee - We need to talk about gaslighting (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Blaine Coleman, resident, presented a video of his wife who is currently in Tehran, Iran. He urged Council to support a resolution opposing military aid to Israel.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Blaine Coleman - We are against military aid to Israel (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Erick Brown, resident, was not present.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Erick Brown - Earth Day (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Andre Watson, resident, spoke about the City's Juneteenth celebration. He urged all to attend the event.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Andre Watson - Juneteenth Celebrations (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Lynne Lande, Northfield Township resident, spoke about the City's history and support of the Juneteenth celebration in the City. She thanked the City Council and invited them to attend the celebration.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Lynne Lande - Juneteenth Celebrations (in person)
